src/plugins/builtin/account-management/p.hasSession || apiClient.isSignedIn(): Signed out, every tab is the same sign-in wall.

src/plugins/builtin/analytics/index.tsx.portfolioTabs.length > 0: The tabs are the user's portfolios; with none there is nothing to choose between.

src/plugins/builtin/congress-trades/pane.tickerFilter: A ticker's own congressional trades are one list; the Trades, Members and Tickers tabs belong to the whole-market view.

src/plugins/builtin/debt-maturities/pane.symbol && !signInWall: No ticker yet, or signed out: every tab would be the same prompt or sign-in wall.

src/plugins/builtin/earnings-ripple/pane.holdings.length: No holdings to ripple from yet: the pane says how to add them instead of offering views of nothing.

src/plugins/builtin/estimate-revisions/p.!symbol || signInWall: No ticker yet, or signed out: every tab would be the same prompt or sign-in wall.

src/plugins/builtin/gpu/pane.tsx.!signIn: Signed out or unverified, every tab is the same sign-in wall.

src/plugins/builtin/portfolio-list/pane/.showCollectionTabs: The tabs are the pane's collections; a single collection has nothing to switch to.

src/plugins/builtin/power/pane.tsx.!signInWall: Signed out, every tab is the same sign-in wall.

src/plugins/builtin/research-search/pane.signInRequired || verificationRequired: Signed out or unverified, every mode is the same sign-in wall.
